source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 荒野仙女池塘实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Tia_the_Fairy (2026-08-11 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Tia_the_Fairy
note: 仙女 Tia,荒野仙女池塘边收仙女之魂的仙女(职务型称呼「仙女 Tia」沿用 Progression_Alerts_Live.json)。开场是带着哀伤的温柔;Abiphone 里则活泼跳脱,爱用感叹号,最后还讲冷笑话。花园访客台词在 Farming/NPC_Message/Tia_the_Fairy.json。
source_note: 首次对话四句已实测;9f™ 网络中继那一串只有 minecraft.wiki 有,未实测,不写 raw/segments。

messages.raw: §fWelcome to the §dFairy Pond§f, §b%s§f! I am Tia.
messages.text: Welcome to the Fairy Pond, %s! I am Tia.
messages.gloss: Fairy Pond → 仙女池塘,同 _shared/Terms.json 新增的地名。
messages.zh: 欢迎来到仙女池塘,%s! 我是 Tia。

messages.raw: §fYou may have noticed some strange orbs laying around the island.
messages.text: You may have noticed some strange orbs laying around the island.
messages.zh: 你也许注意到了,岛上散落着一些奇怪的光球。

messages.raw: §fThey are the souls of my fallen sisters.
messages.text: They are the souls of my fallen sisters.
messages.zh: 那是我逝去的姐妹们的灵魂。

messages.raw: §fIf you find any more during your travels, please bring them back to me!
messages.text: If you find any more during your travels, please bring them back to me!
messages.zh: 旅途中要是再找到,请把它们带回来给我!

messages.text: ✆ You have an Abiphone!
messages.zh: ✆ 你有 Abiphone 啦!

messages.text: ✆ That's super cool!
messages.zh: ✆ 太酷了!

messages.text: ✆ Did you know the fairies helped the mages build the Abiphone's 9f™ network?
messages.gloss: 9f™ 是自造品牌名,保留英文。
messages.zh: ✆ 你知道吗? Abiphone 的 9f™ 网络,是我们仙女帮法师们一起建的。

messages.text: ✆ But since so many of us are now missing, we're behind on maintenance!
messages.zh: ✆ 可我们失踪了太多姐妹,维护工作早就落下了!

messages.text: ✆ Come back wearing Fairy Armor and I can add a 9f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone so you can help us out!
messages.zh: ✆ 穿上仙女护甲再来,我就能给你的 Abiphone 装上 9f™ 运营商芯片,你就能帮上忙了!

messages.text: ✆ Sweet uniform!
messages.zh: ✆ 制服真好看!

messages.text: ✆ Okay I added 9f™ Operator Chip to your Abiphone plan.
messages.zh: ✆ 好了,我把 9f™ 运营商芯片加进你的 Abiphone 套餐了。

messages.text: ✆ It will work on any Abiphone as long as I'm in your contacts list.
messages.zh: ✆ 只要我还在你的通讯录里,它在任何 Abiphone 上都能用。

messages.text: ✆ We need to upgrade all of the 9f™ Network Relays spread across SkyBlock.
messages.zh: ✆ 我们得把分布在 SkyBlock 各处的 9f™ 网络中继全部升级一遍。

messages.text: ✆ Call me and I can tell you where the first relay is!
messages.zh: ✆ 打给我,我告诉你第一个中继在哪儿!

messages.text: ✆ You need more contacts before you can deal with the next relay!
messages.zh: ✆ 你的联系人还不够多,还处理不了下一个中继!

messages.text: ✆ Don't ask me why...
messages.zh: ✆ 别问我为什么……

messages.text: ✆ I don't make the rules!
messages.zh: ✆ 规矩又不是我定的!

messages.text: ✆ Hey! It's you! On the Abiphone!!!
messages.zh: ✆ 嘿! 是你! 打的是 Abiphone!!!

messages.text: ✆ The first relay is on a branch of the large tree on the north-east of the fairy pond.
messages.zh: ✆ 第一个中继在仙女池塘东北边那棵大树的树枝上。

messages.text: ✆ Make sure to wear Fairy Armor!
messages.zh: ✆ 记得穿上仙女护甲!

messages.text: ✆ I don't personally know what the maintenance procedure is, but I'm sure you can figure it out!
messages.zh: ✆ 维护流程我自己也不清楚,但我相信你能琢磨出来!

messages.text: ✆ Wow, you figured out the maintenance plan!
messages.zh: ✆ 哇,你把维护方案搞明白了!

messages.text: ✆ That's really smart!
messages.zh: ✆ 真聪明!

messages.text: ✆ The next relay is in the castle ruins!
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在城堡废墟里!

messages.text: ✆ The next relay is in the Royal Palace within the Dwarven Mines.
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在矮人矿山的皇家宫殿里。

messages.text: ✆ It's in a very high place to reverb the signal for the royal council.
messages.zh: ✆ 它装在很高的地方,好把信号传给王室议会。

messages.text: ✆ Although I don't think technology can help with their communication problems...
messages.zh: ✆ 不过我觉得,他们之间的沟通问题,科技也帮不上忙……

messages.text: ✆ The next relay is on the highest spike of The End.
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在末地最高的那根尖塔上。

messages.text: ✆ It's on the face which looks at the moon rising.
messages.zh: ✆ 在朝着月亮升起的那一面。

messages.text: ✆ Or the sun! If you're that kind of person...
messages.zh: ✆ 或者说朝着太阳! 如果你是那种人的话……

messages.text: ✆ The next relay was placed by our consultant, Odger.
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继是我们的顾问 Odger 装的。

messages.text: ✆ He said "Travel too far home. Bye." after installing it and never called again.
messages.zh: ✆ 他装完只说了句“回家路太远。拜。”,之后再没打过电话。

messages.text: ✆ Maybe he can tell you where he put the relay?
messages.zh: ✆ 说不定他能告诉你中继装在哪儿?

messages.text: ✆ Scarleton itself has one of the most robust connection to the 9f™ Network.
messages.gloss: Scarleton 是绯红岛的城镇名,自造地名,保留英文。
messages.zh: ✆ Scarleton 本身就是 9f™ 网络信号最强的地方之一。

messages.text: ✆ If you face the cathedral, there is a relay at the top of the left tower.
messages.zh: ✆ 面朝大教堂,左边塔楼的顶上就有一个中继。

messages.text: ✆ The next relay is on top of the shack next to the shady inn right here close to the pond.
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继就在池塘附近那家可疑小旅馆旁边的小屋顶上。

messages.text: ✆ Usually we wouldn't have a relay serve so few people, but we were paid generously by anonymous contributors!
messages.zh: ✆ 平时我们不会为这么少的人专门架一个中继,不过有匿名人士出手阔绰!

messages.text: ✆ So generously in fact that we also share some of the data from the 9f™ Network with one of the mayor candidates.
messages.zh: ✆ 阔绰到我们还把 9f™ 网络的一部分数据分享给了某位市长候选人。

messages.text: ✆ But hey, let's keep this between us!
messages.zh: ✆ 不过嘿,这事你知我知就行!

messages.text: ✆ They'll know if you tell anyone.
messages.zh: ✆ 你要是说出去,他们会知道的。

messages.text: ✆ The next relay is on top of a statue in the dungeon hub.
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在地牢大厅的一座雕像顶上。

messages.text: ✆ The one that doesn't have a fairy soul...
messages.zh: ✆ 就是没有仙女之魂的那座……

messages.text: ✆ The next relay is on top of the Auction House.
messages.zh: ✆ 下一个中继在拍卖行的屋顶上。

messages.text: ✆ It offers service to the whole village!
messages.zh: ✆ 整个村庄的信号都靠它!

messages.context: 全部中继完成后打电话
messages.text: ✆ Why is the tooth fairy so smart?
messages.zh: ✆ 为什么牙仙那么聪明?

messages.text: ✆ Because she has wisdom teeth!
messages.zh: ✆ 因为她有智齿!
